**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4616-gallery-full-registration`.

**PM ruling (delegated, veto window open) — the gallery page's purpose decides the default, measurement gates it:** the catalog gallery exists to render the WHOLE catalog, so its baseline is eager registration of every plugin the entries need — extend `registerCatalogBlocks` (the #4615 mechanism) to the full bucket list from this card's census. That default is GATED by measurement, not assumed:

1. **Measure the cost first**: the gallery page's prerender time and client bundle delta with all plugins registered vs today (next build's own route-size output is the instrument). Report before/after verbatim. STOP CONDITION: if the gallery route's first-load JS grows by more than ~50% or prerender breaks, stop at the census + numbers and report — the fallback (per-bucket lazy `registerLazy`/dynamic import with a loading tile) becomes its own decision rather than a silent substitution.
2. Within budget ⇒ register all buckets; extend the #4615 render pin from plugin-dashboard to EVERY category (no OBJUI-001 tile, no error tile, every authored title present — the same non-vacuity discipline), red-first against today's 35 (capture the true count per bucket verbatim).
3. Entries that still fail for reasons OTHER than registration (their own shape defects, like the pre-#4615 dashboard entries) are NOT silently fixed here: census them, file per-bucket findings for real defects, and scope the pin so it reds on them honestly — say which entries are excluded and why, or fix trivial ones in place if comment-level. ⛔ Do not rewrite entry semantics wholesale — that was (d1)'s per-entry measured work, and each bucket deserves the same care only when its census demands it.
4. `InteractiveDemo`/`LiveSplitDemo` keep their PluginLoader lazy loading (the #4615 separation stands); only the gallery page's registration widens.

Standard playbook: worktree, red-first verbatim, reverse verification (no git stash), repo-root vitest incl. scripts/ (the #3904 site-host guard), gate battery, no changeset owed expected (apps/site + examples ignored — measure), DRAFT PR referencing `Fixes #4616` only if the pin covers all buckets, CI via MCP only, no flip/arm.

Mutual exclusion: #4618's seat (parallel) owns the data-table crash — if a bucket's entries crash into that defect, EXCLUDE them from the pin with a comment naming #4618 rather than chasing it. ⛔ `content/docs/releases/**`; ⛔ metric-card spec-validity (objectstack#8593).
